es.R: Él murió por todos para que la gente que está viva ya no viva solo para agradarse a sí misma. Vivirán {{christos:para Cristo|para el Mesías}}, que murió por ellos y volvió a la vida.

sw.L: Naye alikufa kwa ajili ya wote, ili walio hai wasiishi tena kwa ajili yao wenyewe, bali kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ambaye kwa ajili yao alikufa na kufufuliwa.
sw.B: Alikufa kwa ajili ya wote, ili wale walio hai wasiishi tena kwa ajili yao wenyewe, bali kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} aliyekufa na kufufuliwa kwa ajili yao.
sw.R: Alikufa kwa ajili ya kila mtu ili watu walio hai wasiishi tena kwa kujipendeza wenyewe tu. Wataishi kwa ajili ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, aliyekufa kwa ajili yao na kufufuliwa.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chết thay cho mọi người, để những người đang sống không còn sống cho chính mình nữa, nhưng sống cho Đấng đã chết và đã được làm cho sống lại vì họ.
vi.B: Ngài đã chết thay cho mọi người, để những người đang sống không còn sống cho chính mình nữa, nhưng sống cho Đấng đã chết và đã được sống lại vì họ.
vi.R: Ngài đã chết cho mọi người, để những người đang sống không chỉ sống để làm vui lòng chính mình nữa. Họ sẽ sống cho {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, là Đấng đã chết cho họ và đã được sống lại.

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 모든 사람을 위하여 죽으신 것은, 살아 있는 사람들이 더 이상 자기 자신을 위하여 살지 않고, 그들을 위하여 죽으셨다가 살리심을 받으신 분을 위하여 살게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 그분이 모든 사람을 위해 죽으신 것은, 살아 있는 사람들이 이제는 자기 자신을 위해 살지 않고, 그들을 위해 죽으시고 다시 살아나신 분을 위해 살게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.R: 그분은 모든 사람을 위해 죽으셨습니다. 그것은 살아 있는 사람들이 이제 자기 자신을 기쁘게 하려고만 살지 않게 하려는 것이었습니다. 그들은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 위해 살 것입니다. 그분은 그들을 위해 죽으셨고 다시 살아나셨습니다.

pt.L: E por todos {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} morreu, para que os que vivem não vivam mais para si mesmos, mas para aquele que por eles morreu e foi ressuscitado.
pt.B: Ele morreu por todos, para que os que vivem não vivam mais para si mesmos, mas para aquele que morreu e foi ressuscitado por eles.
pt.R: Ele morreu por todos, para que as pessoas que estão vivas não vivam mais só para agradar a si mesmas. Elas vão viver para {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}, que morreu por elas e foi ressuscitado.

decisions.choice: so that: the purpose of Christ's death is a new direction for life
decisions.reason: ἵνα states purpose. Christ died not only so that people would be forgiven but so that their lives would belong to him.

decisions.choice: the living: those now alive, who have died with Christ and live by him
decisions.reason: οἱ ζῶντες stands against "all died" in verse 14: those included in Christ's death now live a new life, which is the new creation of verse 17.

decisions.choice: on their behalf goes with both verbs: he died and was raised for them
alternatives: for them goes only with died
decisions.reason: ὑπὲρ αὐτῶν stands before both participles. Paul says the same in Romans 4:25: he was handed over for our trespasses and raised for our justification. The passive ἐγερθέντι implies that God raised him.

decisions.choice: Christ
decisions.reason: Readable names Christ where the Greek says "the one".

decisions.choice: on behalf of all he died (L); He died on behalf of all (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek order, which puts "on behalf of all" first to link with verse 14.

decisions.choice: resucitó
decisions.reason: The Greek is passive, "was raised" by God. Spanish commonly uses "resucitó" for this, and the passive "fue resucitado" sounds stiff; the meaning is unchanged, and 4:14 already says that God raised Jesus.

source.text: Ὥστε ἡμεῖς ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν οὐδένα οἴδαμεν κατὰ σάρκα· εἰ καὶ ἐγνώκαμεν κατὰ σάρκα Χριστόν, ἀλλὰ νῦν οὐκέτι γινώσκομεν.

records.literal_gloss: So that we from the now no one know according to flesh; if even we have known according to flesh Christ, yet now no longer we know [him].

en.L: So from now on we know no one according to [the] flesh; even if we have known {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} according to [the] flesh, yet now we no longer know [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} so].
en.B: So from now on we look at no one by merely human standards. Even if we once knew {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} by those standards, that is not how we know {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} now.
en.R: So from now on we do not judge anyone by the way things look to human eyes. At one time we thought about {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} in that way too, but we do not think of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} like that anymore.

fr.L: Ainsi nous, désormais, nous ne connaissons personne selon la chair ; même si nous avons connu le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} selon la chair, maintenant pourtant nous ne [{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}] connaissons plus [ainsi].
fr.B: Ainsi, désormais, nous ne regardons plus personne selon des critères purement humains. Même si nous avons autrefois connu le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} de cette manière, ce n’est plus ainsi que nous {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} connaissons maintenant.
fr.R: Alors, maintenant, nous ne jugeons plus personne d’après ce que voient les yeux humains. Autrefois, nous pensions aussi au {{christos:Christ|Messie}} de cette façon, mais nous ne pensons plus à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} comme cela.

es.L: De modo que nosotros, desde ahora, no conocemos a nadie según [la] carne; aunque hayamos conocido {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}} según [la] carne, ahora ya no [{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} conocemos así].
es.B: Así que, desde ahora, no miramos a nadie con criterios meramente humanos. Aunque antes conocimos {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}} con esos criterios, ya no {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} conocemos así.
es.R: Así que, desde ahora, no juzgamos a nadie por cómo se ven las cosas a ojos humanos. Antes pensábamos así también acerca {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, pero ya no pensamos así de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo sisi tangu sasa hatumjui mtu yeyote kwa kufuata mwili; hata ikiwa tumemjua {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} kwa kufuata mwili, lakini sasa hatumjui tena [hivyo].
sw.B: Kwa hiyo tangu sasa hatumtazami mtu yeyote kwa vipimo vya kibinadamu tu. Hata kama hapo kwanza tulimjua {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} kwa vipimo hivyo, sasa hatumjui hivyo tena.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo tangu sasa hatumhukumu mtu yeyote kwa jinsi mambo yanavyoonekana kwa macho ya kibinadamu. Wakati fulani tulimfikiria {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} kwa namna hiyo pia, lakini sasa hatumfikirii hivyo tena.

vi.L: Vậy từ nay chúng tôi không biết ai theo xác thịt; dù chúng tôi đã từng biết {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} theo xác thịt, nhưng nay chúng tôi không còn biết [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như thế] nữa.
vi.B: Vậy, từ nay chúng tôi không nhìn ai theo tiêu chuẩn thuần túy con người. Dù trước kia chúng tôi đã từng biết {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} theo tiêu chuẩn ấy, thì nay chúng tôi không còn biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như vậy nữa.
vi.R: Vậy từ nay chúng tôi không đánh giá ai theo cách con người nhìn bên ngoài. Có một thời chúng tôi cũng đã nghĩ về {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} theo cách ấy, nhưng nay chúng tôi không còn nghĩ về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như thế nữa.

ko.L: 그러므로 우리는 이제부터 아무도 육신을 따라 알지 않습니다. 비록 우리가 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}도 육신을 따라 알았을지라도, 이제는 더 이상 그렇게 알지 않습니다.
ko.B: 그래서 우리는 이제부터 아무도 사람의 기준으로 보지 않습니다. 우리가 한때 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 그런 기준으로 알았다 하더라도, 이제는 그분을 그렇게 알지 않습니다.
ko.R: 그래서 이제부터 우리는 아무도 사람의 눈에 보이는 대로 판단하지 않습니다. 한때 우리는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}에 대해서도 그런 식으로 생각했습니다. 그러나 이제는 더 이상 그분을 그렇게 생각하지 않습니다.

pt.L: De modo que nós, de agora em diante, não conhecemos ninguém segundo [a] carne; ainda que tenhamos conhecido {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} segundo [a] carne, agora já não [{{deity_pronoun:o|O}}] conhecemos [assim].
pt.B: Por isso, de agora em diante, não olhamos para ninguém segundo critérios meramente humanos. Ainda que um dia tenhamos conhecido {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} segundo esses critérios, não é assim que {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} conhecemos agora.
pt.R: Por isso, de agora em diante, não julgamos ninguém pelo que os olhos humanos veem. Houve um tempo em que também pensávamos assim a respeito {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}, mas não pensamos mais assim a respeito {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.

decisions.choice: so: what follows from verses 14-15
decisions.reason: Ὥστε draws the conclusion: since all have died with Christ and live for him, Paul no longer sees anyone in the old way.

decisions.choice: according to the flesh: by merely human standards, the way people judge without God
decisions.reason: κατὰ σάρκα describes a way of knowing, as in 1:17 and 10:2, where Paul's critics say he lives "according to the flesh". It is judging by outward things, the "face" of verse 12.

decisions.choice: the phrase goes with the verb: knowing Christ in a merely human way, not "Christ in the flesh"
alternatives: knowing the earthly Jesus personally, which Paul now sets aside
decisions.reason: The phrase stands between the verb and Χριστόν, and in the first half of the verse it plainly goes with "know". So Paul is not dismissing the earthly life of Jesus; he is saying he once judged Christ by human standards. As a persecutor he took the crucified Jesus to be accursed (Galatians 1:13; 3:13; 1 Corinthians 1:23). The words do not say whether Paul ever saw Jesus during his earthly life.

decisions.choice: even if: granting that it was so
decisions.reason: εἰ καὶ with the perfect ἐγνώκαμεν grants something true of Paul's past. "We" is Paul here, who once persecuted the church.

decisions.choice: by merely human standards (B); by the way things look to human eyes (R)
alternatives: from a worldly point of view
decisions.reason: As in 1:17, Literal keeps "flesh", while Balanced and Readable give the sense (m2). "Worldly" is avoided because it would blur the word with "world".

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: kwa kufuata mwili (L); kwa vipimo vya kibinadamu tu (B); kwa macho ya kibinadamu (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:17: Literal keeps "mwili" (flesh); Balanced and Readable say what it means here, merely human standards. The object "him" is inside the verbs ("hatumjui", "hatumfikirii"), so Swahili has no deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: "theo xác thịt" (L); "theo tiêu chuẩn thuần túy con người" (B), going with the verb
alternatives: "Đấng Christ theo xác thịt" read as Christ's earthly life
decisions.reason: The phrase goes with "know", not with "Christ" (m3): a merely human way of knowing. Literal keeps "xác thịt" for sarx; its word order puts the phrase after the verb, as the Greek does.

decisions.choice: "육신을 따라" (L); "사람의 기준으로" (B); "사람의 눈에 보이는 대로" (R), with the phrase attached to the verb
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the phrase with the verb, a merely human way of knowing, not "Christ in the flesh"; Korean places it with the verb at every level.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} (with the article in the alternative)
decisions.reason: Portuguese needs the article with "Messias" as an object ("conhecido o Messias"), so the alternative carries it, where the English Literal has none.

source.text: ὥστε εἴ τις ἐν Χριστῷ, καινὴ κτίσις· τὰ ἀρχαῖα παρῆλθεν, ἰδοὺ γέγονεν καινά·

records.literal_gloss: So that if anyone [is] in Christ, new creation; the old things passed away, look, have come to be new [things];

en.L: So if anyone [is] in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, [there is] a new creation; the old things have passed away; look, new things have come into being.
en.B: So if anyone is in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, that person is part of a new creation. The old things have gone, and look, new things have come into being.
en.R: So if anyone is joined to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, God has made a new start, a new creation, and that person belongs to it. The old things are gone. Look, something new has begun!

fr.L: Ainsi, si quelqu’un [est] {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}, [il y a] une création nouvelle ; les choses anciennes sont passées ; voici, des choses nouvelles sont advenues.
fr.B: Ainsi, si quelqu’un est {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}, il fait partie d’une création nouvelle. Les choses anciennes sont passées, et voici que des choses nouvelles sont apparues.
fr.R: Alors, si quelqu’un est uni au {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, Dieu a fait un nouveau départ, une création nouvelle, et cette personne en fait partie. Les choses anciennes ont disparu. Regardez, quelque chose de nouveau a commencé !

es.L: De modo que, si alguno [está] en {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, [hay] una nueva creación; las cosas viejas pasaron; {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}, han llegado a ser cosas nuevas.
es.B: Así que, si alguien está en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, es parte de una nueva creación. Lo viejo ha pasado, y {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}: lo nuevo ha llegado.
es.R: Así que, si alguien está unido {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}, Dios ha hecho un nuevo comienzo, una nueva creación, y esa persona pertenece a ella. Lo viejo ya pasó. {{plural_you:¡Miren|¡Mirad}}, algo nuevo ha comenzado!

sw.L: Kwa hiyo ikiwa mtu yeyote [yuko] katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, [kuna] uumbaji mpya; mambo ya kale yamepita; tazama, mambo mapya yamekuja.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo ikiwa mtu yeyote yuko katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, mtu huyo ni sehemu ya uumbaji mpya. Mambo ya kale yamepita, na tazama, mambo mapya yamekuja.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo ikiwa mtu ameunganishwa na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, Mungu ameanza upya, ameumba kitu kipya, na mtu huyo ni sehemu yake. Mambo ya zamani yamepita. Tazama, jambo jipya limeanza!

vi.L: Vậy nếu ai ở trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, [thì có] một cuộc tạo dựng mới; những điều cũ đã qua đi; kìa, những điều mới đã đến.
vi.B: Vậy nếu ai ở trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, thì người ấy thuộc về một cuộc tạo dựng mới. Những điều cũ đã qua đi, và kìa, những điều mới đã đến.
vi.R: Vậy nếu ai được gắn bó với {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, thì Đức Chúa Trời đã làm một khởi đầu mới, một cuộc tạo dựng mới, và người ấy thuộc về cuộc tạo dựng ấy. Những điều cũ đã qua rồi. Hãy xem, một điều mới đã bắt đầu!

ko.L: 그러므로 누구든지 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에 있으면 새로운 창조가 [있습니다]. 옛것들은 지나갔습니다. 보십시오, 새것들이 생겨났습니다.
ko.B: 그러므로 누구든지 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에 있으면, 그 사람은 새로운 창조에 속한 사람입니다. 옛것은 지나갔습니다. 보십시오, 새것이 생겨났습니다.
ko.R: 그러니 누구든지 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}와 하나가 되면, 하나님께서 새롭게 시작하신 새 창조에 그 사람도 속하게 됩니다. 옛것은 사라졌습니다. 보십시오, 새로운 것이 시작되었습니다!

pt.L: De modo que, se alguém [está] {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}}, [há] nova criação; as coisas antigas passaram; eis que coisas novas vieram a existir.
pt.B: Portanto, se alguém está {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}}, essa pessoa faz parte de uma nova criação. As coisas antigas se foram, e vejam: coisas novas vieram a existir.
pt.R: Por isso, se alguém está unido {{christos:a Cristo|ao Messias}}, Deus fez um novo começo, uma nova criação, e essa pessoa pertence a ela. As coisas antigas acabaram. Vejam: algo novo começou!

decisions.choice: new creation: the new creation God has begun is there, and the person in Christ is part of it
alternatives: he or she is a new creation, a changed individual only
there is a new world, with no stress on the person
decisions.reason: The clause has no verb or subject: "if anyone in Christ, new creation". It can be filled out as "that person is a new creation" or "there is a new creation". In Galatians 6:15 new creation is the new order God brings, and the words that follow here ("the old things have passed away") speak of more than one person. The person in Christ does become new, but as part of what God is doing for the whole creation.

decisions.choice: new creation, old things passed, new things come: the promises of Isaiah
alternatives: Paul's own picture with no Old Testament background
decisions.reason: Isaiah 43:18-19 tells God's people not to remember the former things, because God is doing a new thing; Isaiah 65:17 promises new heavens and a new earth, when the former things will not be remembered. The Greek Old Testament of Isaiah 43:18-19 uses words close to ἀρχαῖα ("old things") and καινά ("new"). Paul says the new age has begun in Christ.

decisions.choice: in Christ: joined to Christ, sharing his death and life
decisions.reason: ἐν Χριστῷ describes union with Christ, as in verses 14-15: those who died with him live for him. It recalls 4:6, where the God of creation has shone in their hearts.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "new things have come into being"
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts read "all things" after the verb, which gives the familiar "all things have become new". The SBLGNT follows the older manuscripts, which lack it; the words may come from Revelation 21:5. Reviewers must check the apparatus.

decisions.choice: have passed away, have come into being: a change already made, whose effects last
decisions.reason: παρῆλθεν is aorist: the old order has gone. γέγονεν is perfect: the new has come and remains. Paul still waits for the resurrection body (verses 1-5), but the new creation has already begun.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: look
decisions.reason: "Behold" is old-fashioned English; "look" keeps the call to see.

decisions.choice: that person is part of a new creation (B); God has made a new start, a new creation, and that person belongs to it (R)
decisions.reason: Both levels fill out the clause with no verb in the way chosen in m1, which is uncertain; the footnote gives the other reading.

decisions.choice: joined to Christ
decisions.reason: Readable says what "in Christ" means (m3).

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}
decisions.reason: Paul is speaking to the Corinthians, so "look" is plural and takes the ustedes/vosotros setting, as the guide gives for "idou" said to a group; "he aquí" is old-fashioned.

decisions.choice: uumbaji mpya
decisions.reason: As in Galatians 6:15: "kiumbe kipya" (a new creature) would name only the person made new, while the meaning decision reads this as the new creation God has begun, of which the person is part. "Uumbaji mpya" says that.

decisions.choice: "một cuộc tạo dựng mới" at every level for kaine ktisis, with "người ấy thuộc về" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Một cuộc tạo dựng mới" is the phrase of the Vietnamese Galatians 6:15 for the same Greek words. The Greek has no verb (m1); Literal brackets "[thì có]", leaving open whether the person is a new creation or belongs to the one God has begun, and Balanced and Readable take the reading of m1, as the English does. "Tạo vật mới" would settle it the other way.

decisions.choice: "kìa" (L), "kìa" (B), "Hãy xem" (R) for idou
decisions.reason: As in 1 Corinthians 15:51 at Literal; here Balanced keeps it too, as the English keeps "look".

decisions.choice: "새로운 창조" (L, B); "새 창조" (R), as in Galatians 6:15
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the verbless phrase as the new creation God has begun, of which the person in Christ is part, uncertain and footnoted; "새로운 창조" keeps the larger sense of Galatians 6:15, where "새로운 피조물" would narrow it to the person.

decisions.choice: "보십시오" for "look" at every level
decisions.reason: The plain call to attention, in the polite style of the letter.

source.text: τὰ δὲ πάντα ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ καταλλάξαντος ἡμᾶς ἑαυτῷ διὰ Χριστοῦ καὶ δόντος ἡμῖν τὴν διακονίαν τῆς καταλλαγῆς, ὡς ὅτι θεὸς ἦν ἐν Χριστῷ κόσμον καταλλάσσων ἑαυτῷ, μὴ λογιζόμενος αὐτοῖς τὰ παραπτώματα αὐτῶν, καὶ θέμενος ἐν ἡμῖν τὸν λόγον τῆς καταλλαγῆς.

records.literal_gloss: The and all things [are] from the God the [one] having reconciled us to himself through Christ and having given to us the ministry of the reconciliation, \v 19 as that God was in Christ world reconciling to himself, not reckoning to them the trespasses of them, and having placed in us the word of the reconciliation.

en.L: And all things [are] from God, who reconciled us to {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} through {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} and gave us the ministry of reconciliation, \v 19 namely, that God was in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} reconciling [the] world to {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having placed in us the word of reconciliation.
en.B: And all of it is God's doing. Through {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has reconciled us to {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has given us the ministry of reconciliation. \v 19 For it was God who, in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, was at work reconciling the world to {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}. He did not hold their trespasses against them, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has put the word of reconciliation in our keeping.
en.R: All of this is God's work. Through {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, God has brought us back to {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has given us the work of bringing others back to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} too. \v 19 This is the message: in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, God was bringing the people of the world back to {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}. He was not keeping a record of their sins against them. And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has trusted us with this message that people can be brought back to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: Et tout [vient] de Dieu, qui nous a réconciliés avec {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} par le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} et nous a donné le ministère de la réconciliation, \v 19 à savoir que Dieu était {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}, réconciliant le monde avec {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}, ne leur comptant pas leurs fautes, et ayant mis en nous la parole de la réconciliation.
fr.B: Et tout cela est l’œuvre de Dieu. Par le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a réconciliés avec {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a confié le ministère de la réconciliation. \v 19 Car c’est Dieu qui, {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}, était à l’œuvre pour réconcilier le monde avec {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}. Il n’a pas retenu leurs fautes contre eux, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a confié la parole de la réconciliation.
fr.R: Tout cela, c’est l’œuvre de Dieu. Par le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, Dieu nous a ramenés à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a donné le travail de ramener les autres à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, eux aussi. \v 19 Voici le message : {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}, Dieu ramenait les gens du monde à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Il ne gardait pas la liste de leurs péchés contre eux. Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a confié ce message : les gens peuvent être ramenés à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

es.L: Y todas las cosas [son] de Dios, que nos reconcilió consigo por medio {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} y nos dio el ministerio de la reconciliación, \v 19 a saber, que Dios estaba en {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} reconciliando [al] mundo consigo, no tomándoles en cuenta sus transgresiones, y habiendo puesto en nosotros la palabra de la reconciliación.
es.B: Y todo esto es obra de Dios. Por medio {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} nos ha reconciliado consigo, y nos ha dado el ministerio de la reconciliación. \v 19 Porque era Dios quien, en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, estaba reconciliando al mundo consigo. No les tomó en cuenta sus transgresiones, y ha puesto en nuestras manos la palabra de la reconciliación.
es.R: Todo esto es obra de Dios. Por medio {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, Dios nos ha traído de vuelta a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}}, y nos ha dado el trabajo de traer también a otros de vuelta a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. \v 19 Este es el mensaje: en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, Dios estaba trayendo de vuelta a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}} a la gente del mundo. No llevaba la cuenta de sus pecados contra ellos. Y nos ha confiado este mensaje: que la gente puede volver a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

sw.L: Na mambo yote [ni] kutoka kwa Mungu, aliyetupatanisha {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} kupitia {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, na kutupa huduma ya upatanisho, \v 19 yaani, kwamba Mungu alikuwa katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} akiupatanisha ulimwengu {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}, bila kuwahesabia makosa yao, akiwa ameweka kwetu neno la upatanisho.
sw.B: Na haya yote ni kazi ya Mungu. Kupitia {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ametupatanisha {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} ametupa huduma ya upatanisho. \v 19 Kwa maana ni Mungu aliyekuwa akitenda kazi katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, akiupatanisha ulimwengu {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}. Hakuwahesabia watu makosa yao, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} ametukabidhi neno la upatanisho.
sw.R: Haya yote ni kazi ya Mungu. Kupitia {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, Mungu ameturudisha {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} ametupa kazi ya kuwarudisha wengine {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} pia. \v 19 Ujumbe ni huu: katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, Mungu alikuwa akiwarudisha watu wa ulimwengu {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}. Hakuwa akiwahesabia dhambi zao. Naye ametukabidhi ujumbe huu, kwamba watu wanaweza kurudishwa {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}.

vi.L: Mọi điều ấy [đều] từ Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng đã hòa giải chúng tôi với chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} qua {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} và đã giao cho chúng tôi chức vụ hòa giải, \v 19 ấy là Đức Chúa Trời đã ở trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} để hòa giải thế gian với chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, không kể những vi phạm của họ cho họ, và đã đặt nơi chúng tôi lời hòa giải.
vi.B: Tất cả những điều ấy đều là công việc của Đức Chúa Trời. Qua {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hòa giải chúng tôi với chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giao cho chúng tôi chức vụ hòa giải. \v 19 Vì chính Đức Chúa Trời, trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, đã hành động để hòa giải thế gian với chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài không kể những vi phạm của họ để buộc tội họ, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giao cho chúng tôi lời hòa giải.
vi.R: Tất cả những điều này là công việc của Đức Chúa Trời. Qua {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, Đức Chúa Trời đã đem chúng tôi trở về với chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giao cho chúng tôi công việc đem người khác trở về với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nữa. \v 19 Đây là sứ điệp: trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, Đức Chúa Trời đã đem người của thế gian trở về với chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài không ghi sổ tội lỗi của họ để buộc tội họ. Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giao phó cho chúng tôi sứ điệp này, là người ta có thể được đem trở về với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 이 모든 것은 하나님께로부터 [나옵니다]. 그분은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 통하여 우리를 자신과 화해시키시고, 우리에게 화해의 직분을 주셨습니다. \v 19 곧 하나님께서 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에서 세상을 자신과 화해시키시며, 그들의 범죄를 그들에게 돌리지 않으시고, 화해의 말씀을 우리에게 맡기셨다는 것입니다.
ko.B: 이 모든 것은 하나님께서 하신 일입니다. 하나님께서는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 통해 우리를 자신과 화해시키시고, 우리에게 화해의 직분을 주셨습니다. \v 19 하나님께서 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에서 세상을 자신과 화해시키고 계셨던 것입니다. 하나님께서는 그들의 범죄를 그들의 탓으로 돌리지 않으시고, 화해의 말씀을 우리에게 맡기셨습니다.
ko.R: 이 모든 것은 하나님께서 하신 일입니다. 하나님께서는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 통해 우리를 하나님께로 다시 돌아오게 하셨습니다. 그리고 다른 사람들도 하나님께로 다시 돌아오게 하는 일을 우리에게 맡기셨습니다. \v 19 그 소식은 이것입니다. 하나님께서 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에서 세상 사람들을 하나님께로 다시 돌아오게 하고 계셨습니다. 하나님께서는 그들의 죄를 장부에 적어 두지 않으셨습니다. 그리고 사람들이 하나님께로 돌아올 수 있다는 이 소식을 우리에게 맡기셨습니다.

pt.L: E todas as coisas [vêm] de Deus, que nos reconciliou {{deity_pronoun:consigo mesmo|Consigo mesmo}} por meio {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}} e nos deu o ministério da reconciliação, \v 19 a saber, que Deus estava {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} reconciliando [o] mundo {{deity_pronoun:consigo mesmo|Consigo mesmo}}, não lhes atribuindo as suas transgressões, e tendo posto em nós a palavra da reconciliação.
pt.B: E tudo isso é obra de Deus. Por meio {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}} {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nos reconciliou {{deity_pronoun:consigo mesmo|Consigo mesmo}} e nos deu o ministério da reconciliação. \v 19 Pois era Deus quem, {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}}, estava agindo para reconciliar o mundo {{deity_pronoun:consigo mesmo|Consigo mesmo}}. Ele não levou em conta as transgressões das pessoas e nos confiou a palavra da reconciliação.
pt.R: Tudo isso é obra de Deus. Por meio {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}, Deus nos trouxe de volta para {{deity_pronoun:si|Si}} e nos deu o trabalho de trazer outras pessoas de volta para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} também. \v 19 Esta é a mensagem: {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}}, Deus estava trazendo as pessoas do mundo de volta para {{deity_pronoun:si|Si}}. Ele não ficava cobrando delas os seus pecados. E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nos confiou esta mensagem: as pessoas podem ser trazidas de volta para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.

decisions.choice: all this is from God: the new creation of verses 14-17 is God's work
alternatives: everything in the universe comes from God
decisions.reason: τὰ δὲ πάντα gathers up what has just been said: Christ's death for all, the new life, the new creation. All of it has its source in God, and the rest of the sentence says how.

decisions.choice: reconcile: to end hostility and restore a broken relationship; God is the one who reconciles, and people are reconciled to him
alternatives: God being reconciled to people, his anger appeased by them
decisions.reason: καταλλάξαντος and καταλλαγῆς are words for changing enemies into friends, used of a husband and wife making peace (1 Corinthians 7:11). In Paul, God always takes the first step: he reconciles people to himself (Romans 5:10-11; Colossians 1:20-22). The hostility to be overcome is on the human side, and the way it is overcome is Christ's death (verse 21).

decisions.choice: namely that: what follows explains the ministry and its message
decisions.reason: ὡς ὅτι is an unusual pairing. It most likely means "that is to say", introducing the content of the ministry of reconciliation.

decisions.choice: God was reconciling the world to himself in Christ: one act of God carried out through Christ
alternatives: "God was in Christ", a statement that God was present in Christ, followed by "reconciling the world"
decisions.reason: ἦν with καταλλάσσων most naturally forms one verb phrase, "was reconciling", and "in Christ" says how, as "through Christ" does in verse 18. The other reading, familiar from older translations, makes "God was in Christ" a statement on its own. That is true (Colossians 1:19; 2:9), but it is not the main point here.

decisions.choice: the world: humankind, the people God reconciles
decisions.reason: κόσμον has no article and is followed by the plural αὐτοῖς ("to them"), so the world here is people. Colossians 1:20 speaks of all things being reconciled; here the stress is on people whose trespasses are not counted.

decisions.choice: not counting their trespasses against them: like crossing debts off an account
decisions.reason: λογιζόμενος is a bookkeeping word, to enter in an account. Psalm 32:2, which Paul quotes in Romans 4:8, calls happy the person against whom the Lord does not count sin. Sin is not ignored: verse 21 says how God dealt with it.

decisions.choice: having placed in us: God has entrusted the message to them
alternatives: placed inside us as an inner experience
decisions.reason: θέμενος ἐν ἡμῖν means to put something in someone's charge. λόγον is the spoken message, which is how the ministry of verse 18 is carried out (verse 20).

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: reconcile, reconciliation
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep one English word family for the Greek family, so the repetition through verses 18-20 can be seen, as in Colossians 1:20-22.

decisions.choice: brought us back to him; bringing others back to him; bringing back; message that people can be brought back to him
decisions.reason: "Reconcile" is not an everyday word for many readers; as in Colossians 1:20-22, Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: trespasses (L, B); sins (R)
decisions.reason: As in Colossians 2:13, Literal and Balanced say "trespasses" for this word, which pictures a false step; Readable uses the everyday word.

decisions.choice: it was God who, in Christ, was at work reconciling
decisions.reason: Balanced puts the stress on God as the one who acts and keeps "in Christ" with the verb, as m4 reads it.

decisions.choice: réconcilier, la réconciliation (L, B); ramener à lui (R) (for the whole book)
decisions.reason: As in Colossians 1:20-22 and the English: Literal and Balanced keep one French family for the Greek family, so the repetition through verses 18-20 can be seen; Readable says what it means, God bringing people back to himself (m2).

decisions.choice: leurs fautes (L, B); leurs péchés (R)
decisions.reason: As in Colossians 2:13 and Romans 5: "faute" is the French word used for a false step against God; Readable uses the everyday word, as the English does.

decisions.choice: reconciliar, reconciliación (L, B); traer de vuelta a sí mismo (R)
decisions.reason: As in Colossians 1:20-22, Literal and Balanced keep "reconciliar"; Readable says what it means for people, that God brings them back to himself, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: consigo, with no span
decisions.reason: "Consigo" is one word joined to the preposition, like "conmigo" and "contigo", so by the Spanish guide it takes no deity_pronoun span; Readable uses the separate "a sí mismo", which does.

decisions.choice: kupatanisha, upatanisho (L, B); kurudisha kwake (R)
decisions.reason: "Kupatanisha" is the Swahili verb for making peace between parties who were at odds, and "upatanisho" its noun, as in Romans 5:10-11. Readable follows the English Readable and says "kurudisha kwake" (bring back to himself).

decisions.choice: bila kuwahesabia makosa yao
decisions.reason: "Kuhesabia" (to count to someone's account) is the bookkeeping verb Swahili Romans uses for God reckoning (Romans 4:8), which keeps the picture of crossing debts off an account (meaning decision). "Makosa" is the word for trespasses, as in Romans 11:11.

decisions.choice: "hòa giải ... với chính Ngài", "chức vụ hòa giải", "lời hòa giải" (L, B); "đem ... trở về với chính Ngài" (R) for katallasso and katallage (5:18-20)
decisions.reason: The book-wide choice ("reconcile, reconciliation"; Readable "bring back to himself") in the words of the Vietnamese Colossians 1:20-22 and Romans 5:10-11. God is the one who reconciles and people are reconciled to him (m2), which the word order keeps.

decisions.choice: "những vi phạm" (L, B), "tội lỗi" (R) for paraptomata; "không kể ... cho họ" (L)
decisions.reason: The words of the Vietnamese Ephesians 2:1 and Colossians 2:13; "kể" is the bookkeeping verb of the Vietnamese Romans 4 (m6).

decisions.choice: "화해시키다", "화해" (L, B); "하나님께로 다시 돌아오게 하다" (R), here and in verse 20
decisions.reason: The words of Romans 5:10-11 and Colossians 1:20-22 for reconciliation (L, B); the meaning decision says God is the one who reconciles and people are reconciled to him, which "화해시키다" with God as subject keeps. Readable follows the English Readable, "bring back to himself", here, where the work of reconciling others is in view.

decisions.choice: "범죄" (L, B), as in Romans 5:15-20; "돌리지 않다" (L), "탓으로 돌리지 않다" (B), "장부에 적어 두지 않다" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision hears a bookkeeping word, as in Romans 4:8; Readable says the picture plainly.

decisions.choice: reconciliar, reconciliação (L, B); trazer de volta para si (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as the Corinthians terms set it. "Reconciliar" is the Portuguese word for ending hostility and restoring a relationship (m2). Readable says "trazer de volta para si", the picture the English Readable uses; "fazer as pazes" would make it sound as if both sides had been at fault.

source.text: ὑπὲρ Χριστοῦ οὖν πρεσβεύομεν ὡς τοῦ θεοῦ παρακαλοῦντος δι’ ἡμῶν· δεόμεθα ὑπὲρ Χριστοῦ, καταλλάγητε τῷ θεῷ.

records.literal_gloss: On behalf of Christ therefore we are ambassadors, as the God appealing through us; we beg on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to the God.

en.L: So on behalf of {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} we are ambassadors, since God is making an appeal through us; we plead [with you] on behalf of {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}: be reconciled to God.
en.B: So we are ambassadors who speak for {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, and it is God {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} who makes {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} appeal through us. Speaking for {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, we plead with you: be reconciled to God.
en.R: So we speak for {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, like ambassadors sent by a king. God is using us to call out to people. Speaking for {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, we beg you: Let God bring you back to {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}!

fr.L: Pour le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} donc nous sommes ambassadeurs, puisque c’est Dieu qui exhorte par nous ; nous [vous] supplions pour le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} : soyez réconciliés avec Dieu.
fr.B: Nous sommes donc des ambassadeurs qui parlent au nom du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, et c’est Dieu {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} qui lance {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} appel par nous. Au nom du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, nous vous en supplions : soyez réconciliés avec Dieu.
fr.R: Alors nous parlons au nom du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, comme des ambassadeurs envoyés par un roi. Dieu se sert de nous pour appeler les gens. Au nom du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, nous vous en supplions : laissez Dieu vous ramener à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} !

es.L: Así que, en nombre {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} somos embajadores, como si Dios exhortara por medio de nosotros; [{{plural_you:les|os}}] rogamos en nombre {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}: {{plural_you:reconcíliense|reconciliaos}} con Dios.
es.B: Así que somos embajadores que hablan en nombre {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, y es Dios mismo quien hace {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} llamado por medio de nosotros. En nombre {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} {{plural_you:les|os}} rogamos: {{plural_you:reconcíliense|reconciliaos}} con Dios.
es.R: Así que hablamos en nombre {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, como embajadores enviados por un rey. Dios nos está usando para llamar a la gente. En nombre {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} suplicamos: {{plural_you:¡Dejen|¡Dejad}} que Dios {{plural_you:los|os}} traiga de vuelta a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}}!

sw.L: Basi kwa ajili ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} sisi ni mabalozi, kwa kuwa Mungu anasihi kupitia sisi; tunawasihi kwa ajili ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}: mpatanishwe na Mungu.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo sisi ni mabalozi tunaozungumza kwa niaba ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, na ni Mungu {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} anayetoa wito {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kupitia sisi. Tukizungumza kwa niaba ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, tunawasihi: mpatanishwe na Mungu.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo tunazungumza kwa niaba ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, kama mabalozi waliotumwa na mfalme. Mungu anatutumia kuwaita watu. Tukizungumza kwa niaba ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, tunawaomba sana: Mruhusuni Mungu awarudishe {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}!

vi.L: Vậy chúng tôi là sứ giả thay mặt {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, như thể Đức Chúa Trời đang nài khuyên qua chúng tôi; chúng tôi thay mặt {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} mà nài xin [anh chị em]: hãy hòa giải với Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Vậy chúng tôi là những sứ giả nói thay cho {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, và chính Đức Chúa Trời đang nài khuyên qua chúng tôi. Thay mặt {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, chúng tôi nài xin anh chị em: hãy để Đức Chúa Trời hòa giải anh chị em với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Vậy chúng tôi nói thay cho {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, như những sứ giả được vua sai đi. Đức Chúa Trời đang dùng chúng tôi để kêu gọi người ta. Thay mặt {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, chúng tôi nài xin anh chị em: Hãy để Đức Chúa Trời đem anh chị em trở về với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!

ko.L: 그러므로 우리는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 대신하는 사신입니다. 하나님께서 우리를 통하여 호소하시니, 우리는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 대신하여 [여러분에게] 간청합니다. 하나님과 화해하십시오.
ko.B: 그러므로 우리는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 대신하여 말하는 사신입니다. 하나님께서 친히 우리를 통해 호소하십니다. 우리는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 대신하여 여러분에게 간청합니다. 하나님과 화해하십시오.
ko.R: 그러니 우리는 왕이 보낸 사신처럼 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 대신하여 말합니다. 하나님께서 우리를 사용하셔서 사람들을 부르고 계십니다. 우리는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 대신하여 여러분에게 간절히 부탁합니다. 하나님께서 여러분을 그분께로 다시 돌아오게 하시도록 하십시오!

pt.L: Assim, em nome {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}} somos embaixadores, visto que Deus faz um apelo por meio de nós; suplicamos [a vocês] em nome {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}: sejam reconciliados com Deus.
pt.B: Portanto, somos embaixadores que falam em nome {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}, e é o próprio Deus que faz o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} apelo por meio de nós. Falando em nome {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}, suplicamos a vocês: deixem-se reconciliar com Deus.
pt.R: Por isso falamos em nome {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}, como embaixadores enviados por um rei. Deus está nos usando para chamar as pessoas. Falando em nome {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}, pedimos com insistência a vocês: Deixem que Deus traga vocês de volta para {{deity_pronoun:si|Si}}!

decisions.choice: ambassadors: official envoys who speak with the authority of the one who sends them
alternatives: messengers with no authority of their own
decisions.reason: πρεσβεύομεν was used of envoys sent by a king or a city, and of the emperor's representatives in the provinces. An ambassador speaks the sender's words, not his own. Paul calls himself an ambassador in chains in Ephesians 6:20.

decisions.choice: since God is appealing through us: a fact, not a pretense
alternatives: "as though God were appealing", as if it only seemed so
decisions.reason: ὡς with the genitive absolute gives the way the ambassadors see their task: God himself is making his appeal through them. It does not suggest that God only seems to speak.

decisions.choice: appeal, plead: to urge earnestly
decisions.reason: παρακαλοῦντος is the verb translated "comfort" in chapter 1, but here, beside δεόμεθα ("we beg"), it has its other common sense: to call on someone, to urge.

decisions.choice: be reconciled: a passive command, let God reconcile you
decisions.reason: καταλλάγητε is passive. People do not bring about the reconciliation; God does (verses 18-19). The command calls on them to accept it.

decisions.choice: the appeal is the gospel's call to all, and Paul presses it on the Corinthians too
decisions.reason: The verb has no object. Verses 18-19 describe the message Paul takes to the world, but in 6:1 he turns to the Corinthians and urges them not to receive the grace of God in vain. Some of them had been drawn away from Paul and his message, so the appeal applies to them as well.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: [with you] (L); with you (B); you (R)
decisions.reason: English needs an object for "plead"; "you" can mean the Corinthians or anyone who hears, as m5 reads it.

decisions.choice: like ambassadors sent by a king; Let God bring you back to himself
alternatives: we are ambassadors; be reconciled to God
decisions.reason: Readable explains "ambassadors" (m1), and says "be reconciled" as God's action that people accept (m4), as it does with "reconcile" in verses 18-19.

decisions.choice: como si Dios exhortara
decisions.reason: Spanish "como si" can sound like a pretense, which the meaning decision rules out; it is kept at Literal as the usual rendering of the Greek "as", and Balanced states it as a fact: "es Dios mismo quien".

decisions.choice: Dios mismo, with no span
decisions.reason: The English has a pronoun span for "God himself"; Spanish "Dios mismo" uses the noun with "mismo" as an adjective, which takes no span, as the guide says for "Jesús mismo".

decisions.choice: mabalozi
decisions.reason: "Balozi" is the ordinary Swahili word for an ambassador, an official envoy who speaks with the authority of the one who sent him (meaning decision); "wajumbe" (messengers) would lose that authority.

decisions.choice: tunawasihi (no bracket)
decisions.reason: The English Literal brackets "[with you]". Swahili puts the object inside the verb ("tu-na-wa-sihi"), so nothing is bracketed, as the Swahili style guide says.

decisions.choice: "sứ giả" for presbeuo; "hãy hòa giải với Đức Chúa Trời" (L), "hãy để Đức Chúa Trời hòa giải anh chị em với Ngài" (B)
decisions.reason: "Sứ giả" is the word of the Vietnamese Ephesians 6:20 for the same verb. The command is passive (m4), so Balanced and Readable make God the one who acts, as the English Readable does; Literal keeps the short command.

decisions.choice: "사신" at every level for the ambassadors
decisions.reason: The meaning decision describes official envoys who speak with the authority of their sender; "사신" (envoy) is the Korean word for one sent by a king, where "대사" is a modern diplomatic rank.

decisions.choice: "하나님과 화해하십시오" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the passive command as "let God reconcile you"; Korean "화해하다" with "하나님과" is the nearest natural form, and Readable makes God the one who acts.

decisions.choice: deixem-se reconciliar com Deus
decisions.reason: m4 says the command is passive: let God reconcile you. "Reconciliem-se" would make it the readers' own act; "deixem-se reconciliar" keeps God as the one who reconciles.

source.text: τὸν μὴ γνόντα ἁμαρτίαν ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν ἁμαρτίαν ἐποίησεν, ἵνα ἡμεῖς γενώμεθα δικαιοσύνη θεοῦ ἐν αὐτῷ.

records.literal_gloss: The [one] not having known sin on behalf of us sin he made, so that we might become righteousness of God in him.

en.L: The one who did not know sin {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made sin on our behalf, so that we might become [the] righteousness of God in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: {{christos:Christ|The Messiah}} had never known sin, yet for our sake God made {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to be sin, so that, united with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, we might become God's righteousness.
en.R: {{christos:Christ|The Messiah}} never sinned. But for our sake God treated {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} as if {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} were sin itself. God did this so that, because we are joined to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, God's righteousness could become ours.

fr.L: Celui qui n’a pas connu le péché, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a fait péché pour nous, afin que nous devenions justice de Dieu en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} n’avait jamais connu le péché, et pourtant, pour nous, Dieu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a fait péché, afin qu’unis à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, nous devenions la justice de Dieu.
fr.R: Le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} n’a jamais péché. Mais, pour nous, Dieu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a traité comme s’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était le péché lui-même. Dieu a fait cela pour que, parce que nous sommes unis à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, la justice de Dieu puisse devenir la nôtre.

es.L: Al que no conoció pecado, por nosotros {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} hizo pecado, para que nosotros llegáramos a ser [la] justicia de Dios en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: {{christos:Cristo|El Mesías}} nunca había conocido el pecado, y sin embargo, por nosotros, Dios {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} hizo pecado, para que, unidos a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, llegáramos a ser justicia de Dios.
es.R: {{christos:Cristo|El Mesías}} nunca pecó. Pero por nosotros Dios {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} trató como si {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} fuera el pecado mismo. Dios hizo esto para que, porque estamos unidos a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, la justicia de Dios llegara a ser nuestra.

sw.L: Yeye ambaye hakujua dhambi, [Mungu] alimfanya kuwa dhambi kwa ajili yetu, ili sisi tufanyike haki ya Mungu ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} hakuwahi kujua dhambi, lakini kwa ajili yetu Mungu alimfanya kuwa dhambi, ili, tukiwa tumeunganishwa {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}, sisi tufanyike haki ya Mungu.
sw.R: {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} hakutenda dhambi kamwe. Lakini kwa ajili yetu Mungu alimtendea kana kwamba {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni dhambi yenyewe. Mungu alifanya hivyo ili, kwa sababu tumeunganishwa {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}, haki ya Mungu iwe yetu.

vi.L: Đấng không hề biết tội lỗi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho trở nên tội lỗi vì chúng ta, để trong Đấng ấy chúng ta trở nên sự công chính của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} chưa hề biết đến tội lỗi, nhưng vì chúng ta, Đức Chúa Trời đã làm cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trở nên tội lỗi, để khi được hiệp nhất với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, chúng ta trở nên sự công chính của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} chưa bao giờ phạm tội. Nhưng vì chúng ta, Đức Chúa Trời đã đối xử với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như thể {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là chính tội lỗi. Đức Chúa Trời làm như vậy để, vì chúng ta được gắn bó với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, sự công chính của Đức Chúa Trời có thể trở thành của chúng ta.

ko.L: 그분은 죄를 알지도 못하신 분을 우리를 위하여 죄로 삼으셨습니다. 이는 우리가 그분 안에서 하나님의 의가 되게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서는 죄를 전혀 알지 못하셨지만, 하나님께서는 우리를 위해 그분을 죄로 삼으셨습니다. 그것은 우리가 그분과 하나가 되어 하나님의 의가 되게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.R: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서는 한 번도 죄를 지으신 적이 없습니다. 그러나 하나님께서는 우리를 위해 그분을 마치 죄 자체인 것처럼 대하셨습니다. 하나님께서 그렇게 하신 것은 우리가 그분과 하나가 되어 하나님의 의를 우리 것으로 얻게 하시려는 것이었습니다.

pt.L: Aquele que não conheceu pecado, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} [o] fez pecado por nós, para que nós nos tornássemos [a] justiça de Deus {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}}.
pt.B: {{christos:Cristo|O Messias}} nunca tinha conhecido o pecado, mas por nossa causa Deus {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} fez pecado, para que, unidos a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, nos tornássemos justiça de Deus.
pt.R: {{christos:Cristo|O Messias}} nunca pecou. Mas, por nossa causa, Deus {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} tratou como se {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fosse o próprio pecado. Deus fez isso para que, por estarmos unidos a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, a justiça de Deus pudesse se tornar nossa.

decisions.choice: God is the one who made him sin; the one who knew no sin is Christ
decisions.reason: ἐποίησεν ("he made") has God as its subject, carried on from verse 20. τὸν μὴ γνόντα ἁμαρτίαν ("the one who did not know sin") is Christ, named just before. The object stands first for emphasis.

decisions.choice: did not know sin: had no experience of sin, never sinned
alternatives: did not understand what sin is
decisions.reason: To "know" here is to know by experience. The New Testament says the same of Jesus elsewhere: tempted in every way yet without sin (Hebrews 4:15), he committed no sin (1 Peter 2:22; compare John 8:46).

decisions.choice: made him sin: God identified Christ with sin and dealt with it in him, bearing its judgment
decisions.reason: ἁμαρτίαν ("sin") is the same word as in the first half of the verse, and the repetition is pointed: the sinless one was made sin. The Hebrew word for sin can also mean a sin offering, and the Greek Old Testament sometimes uses this Greek word for the offering (Leviticus 4:24; compare Isaiah 53:10). So Paul may mean that God made Christ an offering for sin (compare Romans 8:3). Either way Christ was not made a sinner; he took the place of sinners and bore what their sin deserved (Galatians 3:13).

decisions.choice: for our sake: on our behalf and in our place
decisions.reason: ὑπὲρ is the word of verses 14-15 ("one died on behalf of all"). What happened to Christ happened for others.

decisions.choice: become the righteousness of God: through union with Christ, believers share the righteousness that comes from God and are put right with him
alternatives: God's own justice as a quality only
a moral goodness that believers achieve
decisions.reason: δικαιοσύνη θεοῦ matches the first half: as Christ was made sin, which was not his own, believers become God's righteousness, which is not their own. In Philippians 3:9 Paul speaks of "the righteousness from God that depends on faith", and in Romans 1:17 and 3:21-26 of God's righteousness shown in putting people right with himself. Paul says "become", not only "receive": it is a new standing and a new life (verse 17).

decisions.choice: in him: in union with Christ
decisions.reason: ἐν αὐτῷ repeats the "in Christ" of verses 17 and 19: it is by being joined to him that believers share what is his.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: no "for" at the start of the verse
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts begin the verse with a word for "for", which links it to verse 20. The SBLGNT follows older manuscripts, which have no link word. The meaning is not changed. Reviewers must check the apparatus.

decisions.choice: Christ ... God
alternatives: the one who knew no sin ... he
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Christ and God, whom the Greek leaves to be understood (m1).

decisions.choice: sin
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the same word in both halves, as the Greek does, which keeps both readings of m3 open; the footnote gives "sin offering".

decisions.choice: treated him as if he were sin itself; because we are joined to him, God's righteousness could become ours
alternatives: made him to be sin; that we might become the righteousness of God in him
decisions.reason: Readable says what being made sin means without choosing between the readings of m3, and turns "become God's righteousness" into a plainer clause (m5).

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a fait péché (L)
decisions.reason: French must repeat the object as a pronoun after the fronted "Celui qui n’a pas connu le péché", so Literal has a span for Christ ("l’") that the English Literal lacks, besides the one for God ("il").

decisions.choice: [Mungu] alimfanya
decisions.reason: The English Literal can leave God unnamed with "he made", but Swahili "alimfanya" after "Yeye ambaye hakujua dhambi" would be read as Christ making someone sin. Literal therefore supplies "[Mungu]", the subject the meaning decision gives.

decisions.choice: "Đấng ấy" (L) for "in him"
decisions.reason: In the Literal sentence "Ngài" already stands for God, the one who acts; "Đấng ấy" points back to Christ, as the Vietnamese Ephesians 1:3 does, so the two are not confused. "Chúng ta" here takes in all believers.

decisions.choice: "죄로 삼으셨습니다" (L, B), "죄 자체인 것처럼 대하셨습니다" (R); "하나님의 의" at every level
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads "made him sin" as God identifying Christ with sin and bearing its judgment in him, uncertain and footnoted with "a sin offering"; Literal and Balanced keep the Greek's bare "sin". "의" is a key term at every level.
